preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 30 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= N <= 1000 for N in N_values)
preconditions.description: Each integer N in the input is between 2 and 1000 inclusive.
The sum of all N values across all test cases does not exceed 1000.

postconditions.expression: all(len(A) == N for A, N in zip(A_values, N_values))
postconditions.description: Each permutation A has length N.

postconditions.expression: all(set(A) == set(range(1, N+1)) for A, N in zip(A_values, N_values))
postconditions.description: Each permutation A is a permutation of the integers from 1 to N.

postconditions.expression: all(medians[i] != medians[i+1] for A, N in zip(A_values, N_values) for medians in [calculate_medians(A)] for i in range(N-1))
postconditions.description: For each permutation A, the medians of all prefixes of length i and i+1 are different.
